claims.statement: Joby's official Electric Skies page dates the Texas flight campaign September 10th through September 15th, 2026.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Electric Skies: Joby's US Tour 2026

claims.statement: Joby's official page labels the Texas event as including electric-air-taxi flights and autonomous demonstration flights.
claims.quote: Electric air taxi and autonomous demo flights
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Electric Skies: Joby's US Tour 2026

claims.statement: The electric air taxi is a piloted aircraft, so the aircraft itself must not be depicted as driverless.
claims.quote: Joby's piloted, all-electric aircraft is designed to deliver fast, quiet, and zero-operating-emissions flight for everyday passenger transportation.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Electric Skies: Joby's US Tour 2026

claims.statement: The current tour page places a separate J208 aircraft at Fort Worth Alliance Airport and describes that airport as an industrial airport used by major freight operators.
claims.quote: our J208 aircraft arrived at Fort Worth Alliance Airport—one of America's largest industrial airports and home to major freight operators
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Electric Skies: Joby's US Tour 2026

claims.statement: Joby's SEC-filed shareholder letter describes the Texas eVTOL work as a week-long campaign of piloted vertical-takeoff-and-landing flights across Dallas-Fort Worth.
claims.quote: As part of the Texas eIPP project, we intend to conduct a week-long campaign of piloted, vertical take-off and landing flights across the Dallas-Fort Worth area
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation Q2 2026 shareholder letter filed with the SEC

claims.statement: TxDOT says the first Texas pilot phase has no passengers and exists to test and validate routes.
claims.quote: The first phase includes testing without passengers and with traditional aircraft like helicopters and fixed-in wing planes. This will help perform tests and validate the appropriate routes.
claims.source_title: Texas Department of Transportation, TxDOT selected for futuristic air taxi testing program

claims.statement: Joby describes later passenger stages as an expected FAA-overseen progression, not as authority already granted for passenger service.
claims.quote: Over time, and with extensive involvement and oversight from the FAA, we expect flights under the eIPP program to progress from those with only a pilot on board, to those carrying non-paying passengers, and eventually paying passengers.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation Q2 2026 shareholder letter filed with the SEC

claims.statement: Joby's target of carrying its first passengers in 2026 is explicitly a company target and remains forward-looking.
claims.quote: In preparation for those flights, we continue to target carrying our first passengers in 2026.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation Q2 2026 shareholder letter filed with the SEC

claims.statement: Joby says its Superpilot autonomy system can fly a conventional Cessna Caravan autonomously; this is distinct from the piloted eVTOL air taxi.
claims.quote: Developed for defense applications, Superpilot enables a conventional Cessna Caravan aircraft to be flown fully autonomously.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation Q2 2026 shareholder letter filed with the SEC

claims.statement: The FAA says the selected Texas project supports regional flights connecting Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and eventually Houston.
claims.quote: Industry partners will support regional flights connecting Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and eventually Houston, with air taxi networks expanding from each city to extend regional reach.
claims.source_title: Federal Aviation Administration, eight eVTOL Integration Pilot Program selections

claims.statement: The FAA says operational experience from the program will inform standards needed for safe advanced-air-mobility operations.
claims.quote: The program will provide valuable operational experience that will inform the standards needed to enable safe Advanced Air Mobility operations.
claims.source_title: Federal Aviation Administration, eight eVTOL Integration Pilot Program selections

claims.statement: Joby has a 45,000-square-foot leased base at Alliance Air Trade Center in Haslet, within Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport.
claims.quote: Joby Aviation, Inc. (NYSE: JOBY) has signed a lease for 45,000 square feet at Alliance Air Trade Center in Haslet, part of Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Joby Aviation Establishes Hub at Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport

claims.statement: The Alliance base is described as supporting future electric-air-taxi operations across Dallas-Fort Worth, not as proof of an existing paid passenger network.
claims.quote: The new hub marks the first major eVTOL aircraft company presence in Texas and will support future electric air taxi operations across the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex.
claims.source_title: Joby Aviation, Joby Aviation Establishes Hub at Perot Field Fort Worth Alliance Airport

claims.statement: The City of Haslet identifies itself as a city in Tarrant County, Texas.
claims.quote: Jurisdiction of the City of Haslet, Tarrant County, Texas.
claims.source_title: City of Haslet planning and zoning agenda

rejected.finding: Joby had already completed the Texas campaign or a first eIPP flight by retrieval time on September 10th.
rejected.reason: The campaign window begins today, but the fetched sources provide no flight log or dated operational report proving a flight had occurred by retrieval time.

rejected.finding: The Joby electric air taxi flying in Dallas-Fort Worth is autonomous or pilotless.
rejected.reason: Joby's own page calls the electric air taxi piloted; the autonomous system is described separately on a conventional Cessna Caravan or J208 aircraft.

rejected.finding: Passengers will ride during the September 10th through 15th campaign.
rejected.reason: TxDOT says the first phase is testing without passengers. Non-paying and paying passengers are explicitly later expected stages.

rejected.finding: The autonomous aircraft is carrying freight during this campaign.
rejected.reason: The official page says autonomous technologies could shape future cargo operations, not that cargo is being carried now.
